sub_fields.name: solutions_message
sub_fields.label: How it works
sub_fields.message: On desktop the scroll plays two videos: “Video 1” opens the chip into layers, “Video 2” zooms to each layer and back. Each item below is one zoom: set the second of Video 2 where its zoom-in ends and where the zoom-out ends (open the video in a player and note the time). Empty videos / timings — the theme’s own chip videos and their timings. Encode both as H.264 MP4 without audio, all-intra (ffmpeg -g 1), black background; the last frame of Video 1 must equal the first frame of Video 2.

sub_fields.name: video_reveal
sub_fields.label: Video 1 — chip opens
sub_fields.instructions: MP4, ~1024×576, all-intra. Empty — the theme video.

sub_fields.name: video_layers
sub_fields.label: Video 2 — zoom to the layers
sub_fields.instructions: MP4, ~1024×576, all-intra. Empty — the theme video.

sub_fields.name: aim

sub_fields.instructions: Where the line from the number points: fractions of the video frame, 0,0 — top left, 1,1 — bottom right.

sub_fields.name: zoom_in
sub_fields.label: Zoom-in ends, s
sub_fields.instructions: Second of Video 2 where the zoom to this layer ends (the item shows).

sub_fields.name: zoom_out
sub_fields.label: Zoom-out ends, s
sub_fields.instructions: Second where the zoom back out ends.
